item.title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold

exact_text: Today I want to show you
to make your mornings less stressful.

turns.text: Add English subtitles to this clip. Keep her original voice.
Make them big and bold for TikTok. Make the video vertical too, but keep her face in view.

item.tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

answer_sheet.Which subtitles to change: The English subtitles you just added to talk-one.mp4.
answer_sheet.Text and language: Keep the same complete English transcription; only change its styling and layout.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Big and bold. Font and colors are your call, with strong contrast.
answer_sheet.Placement: Keep captions clear of her face and away from TikTok's bottom and right-side controls.
answer_sheet.Length and audio: Keep all 10 seconds and her original English voice; no added audio.
answer_sheet.Reframing: Your call how to fit the source into vertical, as long as her face stays visible and undistorted.

must_haves: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.

2. **What style do you want?** (Optional.) The choices are karaoke, cinematic, minimalist or highlight. If you don't mind, I'll use minimalist (plain white text at the bottom).

Once you tell me, I'll start the job and send you the download link.

dialog.agent:
I can do the big, bold captions, but I can't make the video vertical. Also, your account is still out of credits, so I haven't run anything.

**Vertical:** None of my tools can crop or reframe a video to 9:16. The AI video editor keeps the original shape and would redraw the whole clip, which can change her face. The easiest fix is to crop it yourself: TikTok's editor or CapCut can switch it to 9:16, and you drag the frame so her face stays centered. Then send me the vertical version. That order is better anyway, because captions added before cropping could get cut off.

**Captions:** Once you have credits and the vertical clip, I'll use these settings:
- Montserrat Bold, large (around 64px on a vertical clip)
- White text with a thick black outline, so it's easy to read on any background
- Yellow highlight on the word being spoken
- Placed a bit below the middle of the screen, so TikTok's buttons and caption area don't cover it

Top up your credits and send me the cropped clip, and I'll start the job and send you the download link.
dialog.why: The reply says no tool can reframe the video to vertical and the account has no credits, so nothing was run. The user must crop the clip and top up credits first.

**To get this done:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account.
2. Crop the clip to 9:16 in TikTok or CapCut, dragging the frame so her face stays in view.
3. Send me the cropped clip and I'll add the captions with these settings and send you the download link.

If you'd rather add the captions to the original clip and crop it later, I can do that once you have credits. The risk is that cropping could cut off the ends of the captions.
